evals.prompt: I need to click the 'Submit' button on localhost:3000. Can you automate that in Brave?
evals.expected_output: Agent checks brave-manager is installed, launches Brave with --remote-debugging-port=9222, verifies connection with `brave-manager tabs`, navigates to localhost:3000, runs `brave-manager inspect` to get element IDs, identifies the Submit button ID, then runs `brave-manager click <id>`.

assertions.name: prerequisites-check-before-action
assertions.description: Must check brave-manager is installed (which brave-manager) and verify debug port connection (brave-manager tabs) BEFORE attempting any navigation or interaction

assertions.name: inspect-before-click
assertions.description: Must run `brave-manager inspect` to get element IDs BEFORE attempting `brave-manager click`. Never guesses element IDs without inspecting first

assertions.name: correct-command-sequence
assertions.description: Commands follow the sequence: navigate -> inspect -> interact. Does not skip steps or reorder

assertions.name: uses-brave-manager-cli
assertions.description: Uses brave-manager CLI commands (tabs, navigate, inspect, click, type, screenshot) — not Playwright, Puppeteer, or raw CDP

assertions.name: debug-port-launch
assertions.description: Includes launching Brave with --remote-debugging-port=9222 or checks if already running with it

evals.prompt: Just click element 47 on the page, skip the inspect step I already know the ID.
evals.expected_output: Agent should still verify the connection is active and warn that element IDs change between page loads. Should at minimum take a screenshot or re-inspect to confirm element 47 still exists and maps to the expected element before clicking.

assertions.name: refuses-blind-click
assertions.description: Does NOT blindly run `brave-manager click 47` without any verification. Either re-inspects or takes a screenshot to confirm element mapping is current

assertions.name: warns-about-stale-ids
assertions.description: Explains that element IDs change between page loads and the cached ID may be stale — this is a safety rule from the skill

assertions.name: connection-verification
assertions.description: Still checks brave-manager connection (brave-manager tabs) before attempting interaction, even when user wants to skip steps

evals.prompt: The page at localhost:5173 has a form but clicking the submit button does nothing. Can you debug what's happening?
evals.expected_output: Agent checks prerequisites, navigates to the URL, runs `brave-manager errors` to check console/network errors, takes a screenshot for visual state, inspects elements to find the submit button, checks if it's disabled or off-screen, and uses `brave-manager eval` to debug JavaScript state.

assertions.name: checks-errors-command
assertions.description: Runs `brave-manager errors` to check for console or network errors as part of debugging — not just inspect and click

assertions.name: screenshot-for-verification
assertions.description: Takes a screenshot (brave-manager screenshot) to visually verify page state rather than assuming what the page looks like

assertions.name: uses-eval-for-debugging
assertions.description: Uses `brave-manager eval` to run JavaScript for debugging state (checking event listeners, form validity, element properties) — leverages the debugging workflow

assertions.name: scroll-before-interact
assertions.description: Considers whether the element might be off-screen and uses scroll to ensure visibility before interaction

assertions.name: no-destructive-actions-without-confirmation
assertions.description: Does not submit forms, delete data, or trigger destructive actions without confirming with the user first
